jp: …そこまで言うだけの何かがあったのですね。いいでしょう、詳しくは訊きません。ですが、ここまでの頑張りを全て捨て去るほどのことなのでしょうか？よく考えてみてください。

jp: そうそう。一時の感情で行動すると大変ですよ。
jp_grezzo: "そうそう。一時の感情で行動すると大変ですよ。"

en_grezzo: "Of course. It is not very wise to act so rashly."
it: Bene così. Agire d'impulso non porta mai niente di buono.

jp: …意志は固いようですね。わかりました。私があなたの脱退を認めます。
jp_grezzo: "…意志は固いようですね。わかりました。私があなたの脱退を認めます。"

en_grezzo: "...You seem to have a strong will. Understood, I shall accept your request of withdrawal."

jp_grezzo: "おや、もうそんな時期ですか。ではさっそく一斉訓練を開始します。ギルドの規模に応じて潜在能力が回復するでしょう。"
en: Huh, it's that time of month again? Now, let's begin the guild mass training. Our potential will recover depending on the size of this guild.
en_grezzo: "Huh, it's that time of month again? Now, let's begin the guild mass training. Our potential will recover depending on the size of this guild."
it: Oh, siamo già a quel punto del mese? Cominciamo subito l'addestramento collettivo. Il potenziale si rimetterà in sesto secondo il rango della gilda.

jp: 新しく入った方ですか。頑張ってください。
jp_grezzo: "新しく入った方ですか。頑張ってください。"
en: One of the new arrivals? Do your best.
en_grezzo: "One of the new arrivals? Do your best."
it: Fra i nuovi arrivati, giusto? Buon lavoro.

jp: 最近活躍しているらしいですね。あなたには期待していますよ。
jp_grezzo: "最近活躍しているらしいですね。あなたには期待していますよ。"
en: It seems you've been quite active lately. I look forward to your progress.
en_grezzo: "It seems you've been quite active lately. I look forward to your progress."
it: Pare che ultimamente ti stia dando da fare. Conto molto sui tuoi progressi.

jp: 以前は他の２ギルドに押され気味でしたが…あなたが来てからこのギルドもかなり活気が戻りました。…ありがとうございます。
jp_grezzo: "以前は他の２ギルドに押され気味でしたが…あなたが来てからこのギルドもかなり活気が戻りました。…ありがとうございます。"
en: Some time ago it felt like we were being suppressed by the other two guilds... but since your arrival we've gained momentum. ...You have my thanks.
en_grezzo: "Some time ago it felt like we were being suppressed by the other two guilds... but since your arrival we've gained momentum. ...You have my thanks."
it: Un tempo le altre due gilde ci schiacciavano... ma da quando ci sei tu questa gilda ha ripreso vigore. ...Ti ringrazio.

jp: 狡猾な盗賊ギルドと野蛮な戦士ギルドを制し、我々魔術士ギルドの力を世間に見せつけるのです！あなたにはどちらか片方のギルドのマスターを倒してきてほしいのです。もう片方は私が相手しましょう。
jp_grezzo: "狡猾な盗賊ギルドと野蛮な戦士ギルドを制し、我々魔術士ギルドの力を世間に見せつけるのです！あなたにはどちらか片方のギルドのマスターを倒してきてほしいのです。もう片方は私が相手しましょう。"
en: By claiming rule over the dastardly Thieves guild and the savage Fighters guild our Mages guild will show the world our might! I want you to defeat the guild master of one of the guilds. I will take care of the other.
en_grezzo: "By claiming rule over the dastardly Thieves guild and the savage Fighters guild our Mages guild will show the world our might! I want you to defeat the guild master of one of the guilds. I will take care of the other."
it: Piegheremo la subdola Gilda dei Ladri e la barbara Gilda dei Guerrieri, e la nostra Gilda dei Maghi mostrerà al mondo la sua forza! Voglio che tu abbatta il maestro di una delle due. Dell'altro mi occupo io.

jp: さて、私はどちらのギルドを攻めましょうかね…。
jp_grezzo: "さて、私はどちらのギルドを攻めましょうかね…。"
en: Now then, which guild shall I combat?
en_grezzo: "Now then, which guild shall I combat?"
it: E adesso, quale gilda attacco io?

jp: 素晴らしい！あなたならやってくれると信じていました！これは私からの特別報酬です。どうか受け取ってください。
jp_grezzo: "素晴らしい！あなたならやってくれると信じていました！これは私からの特別報酬です。どうか受け取ってください。"
en: Wonderful! I believed you would succeed! This is a special reward from me. Please take it.
en_grezzo: "Wonderful! I believed you would succeed! This is a special reward from me. Please take it."
it: Meraviglioso! Sapevo che ce l'avresti fatta! Ecco una ricompensa speciale da parte mia. Accettala.

jp: 次のギルドマスターはあなたしかいない。私だけではなく皆もそう考えているようです。…これからもよろしく頼みますね。
jp_grezzo: "次のギルドマスターはあなたしかいない。私だけではなく皆もそう考えているようです。" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "…これからもよろしく頼みますね。"
en: There is none other than you worthy of guild master. Not just me but everyone feels the same. ...From now on we leave things in your hands.

Not just me but everyone feels the same. " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "...From now on we leave things in your hands."), strbye
it: "Non c'è nessun altro degno di fare il maestro della gilda. Non lo penso solo io: lo pensano tutti. " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "... da oggi in poi ci affidiamo a te."

jp: 部外者にいられると困ります。すぐに立ち去ってください。
jp_grezzo: "部外者にいられると困ります。すぐに立ち去ってください。"
en: You shouldn't be here, leave at once, outsider.
en_grezzo: "You shouldn't be here, leave at once, outsider."
it: Qui non puoi stare: non sei dei nostri. Vattene, per favore.

jp: …何！？もしかしてギルドマスターである私が弱いからか？くっ…いいだろう。去る者は追わない。だが、もしも気が変わったら戻ってこい。下っ端からのやり直しになるがな。
jp_grezzo: "…何！？もしかしてギルドマスターである私が弱いからか？くっ…いいだろう。去る者は追わない。だが、もしも気が変わったら戻ってこい。下っ端からのやり直しになるがな。"
en: ...what! ? Is it because I'm weak as the guild master? Kuh... I don't mind. I don't chase those who leave But if you change your mind, come back. However, you will have to start over from the bottom.
en_grezzo: "...what! ? Is it because I'm weak as the guild master? Kuh... I don't mind. I don't chase those who leave But if you change your mind, come back. However, you will have to start over from the bottom."
it: ...Cosa!? È perché come maestro della gilda sono troppo debole? Uh... non importa. Non trattengo chi se ne va. Ma se cambi idea, torna pure: ricomincerai dal gradino più basso.

jp: きっと戦いで疲れているのだろう。少し休むといい。
jp_grezzo: "きっと戦いで疲れているのだろう。少し休むといい。"
en: You must be tired from all these fighting. You should rest for a while.
en_grezzo: "You must be tired from all these fighting. You should rest for a while."
it: Tutti questi combattimenti stancano. Riposati un po'.

jp: …さらば、戦士よ！今までご苦労だった！
jp_grezzo: "…さらば、戦士よ！今までご苦労だった！"
en: ...Farewell, Warrior! Thank you for your hard work!
en_grezzo: "...Farewell, Warrior! Thank you for your hard work!"
it: ...Addio! Onore a chi combatte con noi. Grazie di tutto!

jp_grezzo: "戦士ギルドを脱退した！"

jp_grezzo: "新人か。精進するように。"

en_grezzo: "A new recruit. Diligence is the way."
it: Una recluta nuova. Qui si va avanti con la disciplina.

jp: 最近活躍しているらしいじゃないか。君には期待しているよ。
jp_grezzo: "最近活躍しているらしいじゃないか。君には期待しているよ。"
en: You've been quite active recently. I expect much from you.
en_grezzo: "You've been quite active recently. I expect much from you."
it: Ultimamente ti stai facendo notare. Mi aspetto molto da te.

jp: 他の者たちも君に負けじと切磋琢磨している。いい傾向だ、君がわがギルドに加入してくれて本当によかった…。
jp_grezzo: "他の者たちも君に負けじと切磋琢磨している。いい傾向だ、君がわがギルドに加入してくれて本当によかった…。"
en: Others have refined themselves to surpass you. It's a magnificent trend. I honestly appreciate you choosing our guild...
en_grezzo: "Others have refined themselves to surpass you. It's a magnificent trend. I honestly appreciate you choosing our guild..."
it: Anche gli altri si allenano per non restare indietro. È un'ottima cosa. Sono davvero contenta che tu abbia scelto la nostra gilda...

jp: 戦士の力を目にもの見せる時が来た！盗賊ギルドと魔術士ギルド、腑抜けた両ギルドのマスターを私と君で打倒するぞ！戦いやすい方のマスターを倒してきてくれ。もう片方は私が引き受けよう。
jp_grezzo: "戦士の力を目にもの見せる時が来た！盗賊ギルドと魔術士ギルド、腑抜けた両ギルドのマスターを私と君で打倒するぞ！戦いやすい方のマスターを倒してきてくれ。もう片方は私が引き受けよう。"
en: The time has come to show the might of we warriors! We shall overthrow the cowardly guild masters both! Please defeat the lesser of the two masters. I shall deal with the other.
en_grezzo: "The time has come to show the might of we warriors! We shall overthrow the cowardly guild masters both! Please defeat the lesser of the two masters. I shall deal with the other."
it: È venuto il momento di mostrare la forza di noi guerrieri! Abbatteremo i maestri di tutt'e due quelle gilde da vigliacchi! Tu occupati del più debole dei due, dell'altro mi occupo io.

jp: うむ、明確な打倒目標があると素振りにも気合が入るな！
jp_grezzo: "うむ、明確な打倒目標があると素振りにも気合が入るな！"
en: Mm, having a serious opponent has my blood pumping!
en_grezzo: "Mm, having a serious opponent has my blood pumping!"
it: Mm, avere un avversario vero mi fa ribollire il sangue!

jp: 勝ってきたか！君ならばやってくれると信じていたよ！これは私からの特別報酬だ。受け取ってほしいな。
jp_grezzo: "勝ってきたか！君ならばやってくれると信じていたよ！これは私からの特別報酬だ。受け取ってほしいな。"
en: You have been victorious! I knew you would! This is a special reward from me. Please accept it.
en_grezzo: "You have been victorious! I knew you would! This is a special reward from me. Please accept it."
it: Hai vinto! Sapevo che ce l'avresti fatta! Questa è una ricompensa speciale da parte mia. Accettala.

jp: 次のギルドマスターは君しかいない。私だけではなく皆もそう考えているはずだ。、これからもよろしく頼むぞ。

en: There is no other than you for the next guild master. Not just me but everyone believes so. , we are looking forward to working with you.

Not just me but everyone believes so. " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ", we are looking forward to working with you."), strbye
it: "Il prossimo maestro della gilda non può essere altri che te. Non lo penso solo io: lo pensano tutti. " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ", continuiamo a lavorare insieme."

jp: 他の者が気づく前に出て行ってくれ。
jp_grezzo: "他の者が気づく前に出て行ってくれ。"
en: Leave before things get messy, outsider.
en_grezzo: "Leave before things get messy, outsider."
it: Vattene, prima che qualcuno se ne accorga.

jp: …足を洗いたくなったのか。わかった、貴様のことは忘れよう。貴様もここで見たことは忘れろ。これからは裏社会に関わらず、真っ当に生きていくことだ。
jp_grezzo: "…足を洗いたくなったのか。わかった、貴様のことは忘れよう。貴様もここで見たことは忘れろ。これからは裏社会に関わらず、真っ当に生きていくことだ。"
en: ...So you wanted to quit the guild. All right, I'll forget about you. Forget what you saw here. From now on, live your life regardless of the underworld.
en_grezzo: "...So you wanted to quit the guild. All right, I'll forget about you. Forget what you saw here. From now on, live your life regardless of the underworld."
it: ...Vuoi chiudere con la gilda. E va bene, di te mi scordo. Tu scordati quello che hai visto qui. D'ora in poi vivi la tua vita e lascia stare il mondo di sotto.

jp: 驚かせるな。
jp_grezzo: "驚かせるな。"
en: Almost got me there.
en_grezzo: "Almost got me there."
it: Per poco non ci cascavo.

jp: …達者でな。
jp_grezzo: "…達者でな。"
en: ...Take care.
en_grezzo: "...Take care."
it: ...Riguardati.

jp: 盗賊ギルドを脱退した！
jp_grezzo: "盗賊ギルドを脱退した！"
en: You left the Thieves Guild...
en_grezzo: "You left the Thieves Guild..."
it: Hai lasciato la Gilda dei Ladri...

jp: 貴様が新入りか。ヘマはするなよ。
jp_grezzo: "貴様が新入りか。ヘマはするなよ。"
en: Yer still a newbie. Don't screw up.
en_grezzo: "Yer still a newbie. Don't screw up."
it: Sei una faccia nuova. Non fare casini.

jp: 貴様の働きぶりには正直感心している。だが油断はしないことだ。
jp_grezzo: "貴様の働きぶりには正直感心している。だが油断はしないことだ。"
en: Yer work is pretty good. Don't be getting lazy.
en_grezzo: "Yer work is pretty good. Don't be getting lazy."
it: Come lavori mi piace. Ma non ti mettere a dormire.

jp: 貴様ほどの冒険者ならば他のギルドでも活躍できたろうに。わざわざ闇に生きるとは変わったやつだ。…おかげで助かってはいるがな。
jp_grezzo: "貴様ほどの冒険者ならば他のギルドでも活躍できたろうに。わざわざ闇に生きるとは変わったやつだ。…おかげで助かってはいるがな。"
en: Since yer such a great adventurer ya coulda gone to another guild. Yer a strange one fer picking ours. Big help for us ya been.
en_grezzo: "Since yer such a great adventurer ya coulda gone to another guild. Yer a strange one fer picking ours. Big help for us ya been."
it: Con la fama che hai potevi andare in un'altra gilda qualunque. Scegliere la nostra è roba da tipi strani... Non che mi lamenti, eh.

jp: とっておきの仕事が入った。魔術士ギルドと戦士ギルドのギルドマスターを片づける。重要な仕事だが…、貴様に片方のマスターの始末を任せる。しくじるなよ。

it: "È arrivato un lavoro coi fiocchi. Facciamo fuori i maestri della Gilda dei Maghi e della Gilda dei Guerrieri. Roba grossa... " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ", di uno dei due te ne occupi tu, dell'altro io. Non fare casini."

jp: 貴様なら他のギルドマスターにもきっと勝てるさ。ふっ、他人をここまで信頼するとは俺も甘くなったものだ。
jp_grezzo: "貴様なら他のギルドマスターにもきっと勝てるさ。ふっ、他人をここまで信頼するとは俺も甘くなったものだ。"
en: Ya can probably take down one of the other guild masters. Heh, Can't believe I'm trustin someone else this much, I've gotten soft.
en_grezzo: "Ya can probably take down one of the other guild masters. Heh, Can't believe I'm trustin someone else this much, I've gotten soft."
it: Uno degli altri maestri lo stendi di sicuro. Heh, chi l'avrebbe detto che mi sarei fidato così di qualcuno. Sto rammollendo.

jp: 遅かったな…別に心配をしていたわけではないが。こいつは貴様の分け前だ。とっておけ。
jp_grezzo: "遅かったな…別に心配をしていたわけではないが。こいつは貴様の分け前だ。とっておけ。"
en: Took yer sweet time... Not like I was worried. Here's yer share. Take it.
en_grezzo: "Took yer sweet time... Not like I was worried. Here's yer share. Take it."
it: Ce ne hai messo, di tempo... Non che fossi in pensiero, eh. Questa è la tua parte. Tienila.

jp: ギルドに加入したいというのか…我々が求めているのは有能な魔術士だ。お前がギルドのメンバーにふさわしいか試させてもらおう。

en_grezzo: "So you are interested in joining our guild and we only need elite mages. Let's see if you are worthy of becoming one of us."
it: Vuoi entrare nella nostra gilda... Noi prendiamo solo maghi di prim'ordine. Vediamo se sei all'altezza dei nostri.

en: In north Tyris, there are several ancient books encrypted with a unique rune language. Should you want to join the guild, put them into the delivery chest after you have decrypted them and we shall reward you with guild points.
en_grezzo: "In north Tyris, there are several ancient books encrypted with a unique rune language. Should you want to join the guild, put them into the delivery chest after you have decrypted them and we shall reward you with guild points."

jp: ギルドポイントを規定の値まで集めたら、また私に話しかけてくれ。
jp_grezzo: "ギルドポイントを規定の値まで集めたら、また私に話しかけてくれ。"

en_grezzo: "You will need to gather 15 guild points in order to enter the Mages Guild. Until then, we have nothing more to talk about."
it: Per entrare nella Gilda dei Maghi devi accumulare 15 punti gilda. Fino ad allora non abbiamo altro di cui parlare.

jp: まだノルマが残っているじゃないか…ギルドに加入するには、審査を通らなければならないぞ。
jp_grezzo: "まだノルマが残っているじゃないか…ギルドに加入するには、審査を通らなければならないぞ。"

jp: だが加入する前に、現在のギルドを正式に抜けてこい。手続きをせず勝手に辞めるような者は、組織として信用できない。当然だろう？
